name: @epoch/alerts
description: Epoch Alerts kernel (W043) — severity + escalation policy and alert lifecycle over supervision findings: POLICY AS DATA (sealed, versioned escalation-policy records: finding class token + status -> severity -> escalation path with notify targets, escalation delay and re-notify cadence — swapping a policy record changes escalation, no code change); alert records as append-only REVISION CHAINS (idempotent dedup: the same finding state re-evaluated produces the sealed prior alert; state transitions due -> late -> blocked append new revisions, never mutate); escalation ACTIONS as typed W003 action proposals through the W022 authority seam (policy decision FIRST — allow/deny/requires-approval — then typed outcome records; the kernel NEVER executes anything, gateway-bypass-rejected); typed notifications through the OPTIONAL NotificationPort seam with ONE in-memory reference adapter (provider-neutral by construction; provider-vocabulary-rejected at the seam; replay-safe dispatch). NO persistence, NO UI, NO provider vocabulary, NO external providers, NO execution.
